barriers.reason: The patient cannot drive, the daughter who drove today works 7-5 and cannot regularly bring the patient, and the patient feels unsteady with a walker on the bus route requiring a transfer, so getting to the hospital rehab center three mornings a week is uncertain.

alternatives.text: Assess eligibility for ADA Paratransit certification (Northern Illinois Transit Authority, 312-663-HELP) since weakness with a walker may prevent fixed-route bus use; note certification takes time and rides match fixed-route service hours.
Ask the rehab center whether therapy can be scheduled on a day or time when a ride is available, or consolidated to fewer trips.

If the patient has Medicaid or dual coverage, check Medicaid NEMT (managed care: number on plan card; fee-for-service: Transdev 877-725-0569); do not promise a covered ride if coverage is Medicare-only.
